evidence.title: Built by Designers: No Explanation Needed

name: Built by Designers
summary: Showcase of 149 apps, tools, websites and experiments designed and shipped by designers.
description: Built by Designers is a gallery of products — apps, tools, websites and experiments — that designers designed and built themselves, with 149 listed and a detail page per project. The gallery renders with JavaScript, so only its title, description and the catalog's measurements were readable.
contains: each project has a page under /projects/<slug>
sample projects: Algo, Crated, Huephoria, Lightmeter, Panols, Sendinvo, Stickers Gallery, Vessa
